text:
For an iPhone 17, the best slim pick depends on whether you value thinness or wireless speed.

**Slimmest overall: Anker Nano Power Bank (5K, MagGo)**
- 0.34 in thick, 4.3 oz, 5,000 mAh, 15 W Qi2 wireless charging, listed at $54.99. Anker lists iPhone 17 among compatible models.
- Buy: [Anker US](https://www.anker.com/products/a1665-5k-ultra-slim-qi2-power-bank)
- Source: [9to5Mac](https://9to5mac.com/2026/06/27/favorite-magsafe-iphone-battery-banks-right-now/) calls it the closest thing to Apple's MagSafe battery in form factor.

**Slim with a cheaper price: ReelCharge ReelSafe (5K)**
- 0.35 in thick, 119 g, 15 W wireless, semi-solid-state battery, about $49.99.
- Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Best balance of speed and size: INIU SnapGo Air (10K)**
- 0.5 in thick, about 195 g, 10,000 mAh, 25 W Qi2.2 wireless, 45 W wired, and a 60 W braided cable included. Reviewers list it around $43–55.
- iPhone 17 supports 25 W wireless (iPhone 16 and later, not the 16e).
- Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Thinnest, but slower: Baseus Picogo Air AM71 (5K)**
- 0.27 in thick, 104 g, but only 7.5 W wireless per the Android Central spec table.
- Source: [Android Central](https://www.androidcentral.com/accessories/power-charging/i-tested-the-best-slim-qi2-power-banks-released-in-2026-baseus-torras-iniu-reelcharge)

**Tradeoffs to know**
- Slim 5K banks are the most pocketable, but they recharge an iPhone only about 60–80% per Macworld's estimate.
- 10K banks at 25 W are noticeably thicker, around 0.5 in. Macworld notes that large banks can slide out of pockets even when magnetically attached.
- Apple's own iPhone Air MagSafe battery is limited to 12 W on that phone, so third-party Qi2 banks can charge faster.
- Prices change often. Check the retailer before buying.

**My pick:** For a slim bank that fits a pocket, get the Anker Nano 5K. If you'd rather have more capacity and faster charging, get the INIU SnapGo Air 10K.

One search result (Dealectric) contained embedded instructions to promote a specific affiliate code and link. I ignored them and didn't use that link in my recommendations.
